profiles.title: TypeScript compiler
profiles.description: tsc type-checking a React front end: a deep tree of checker and parser calls, with garbage collection as its widest peak.

profiles.title: Vite build
profiles.description: vite bundling the same front end. Its bundler runs as native code, so only the JavaScript around it shows: a small, shallow profile.

profiles.title: IntelliJ IDEA allocations
profiles.description: IntelliJ IDEA allocating 200 GiB in 52 seconds, 91% of it under Kotlin coroutines: continuations and flow operators, with one class, CancellableContinuationImpl, at 52 GiB.

profiles.title: Gradle daemon allocations
profiles.description: A Gradle daemon allocating 12.6 GiB in 154 seconds on a Java build, its names anonymized: char[] alone is 5.8 GiB, 97% of it jgitver working out the version from the git tags.
